note: Extra source details for the vehicle catalog.
sensor_load_included: true = source says the endurance includes the stated payload/sensor; false = source explicitly excludes payload; null = source does not say.

REMUS 100B - 1.5 kWh.sensor_load_basis: Sensor-equipped bathymetric variant; the cited endurance statement does not say whether sensor demand is included.
REMUS 100B - 1.5 kWh.source_note: HII REMUS 100B bathymetric variant: 1.5 kWh, 8 h estimated endurance, up to 4.5 kt.

REMUS 130 - 1.5 kWh.sensor_load_basis: Standard side-scan sonar is listed, but HII does not state whether the 10-h endurance includes the sonar duty cycle.
REMUS 130 - 1.5 kWh.source_note: HII REMUS 130: 1.5-kWh family battery basis, up to 10 h, speeds up to 5 kt. Recharge retained as the existing 6-h planning value.

REMUS 300 - 1.5 kWh.sensor_load_basis: Published endurance condition does not explicitly identify sensor-load inclusion.
REMUS 300 - 1.5 kWh.source_note: HII REMUS 300 1.5-kWh configuration: up to 10 h at 3 kt.

REMUS 300 - 3.0 kWh.sensor_load_basis: Published endurance condition does not explicitly identify sensor-load inclusion.
REMUS 300 - 3.0 kWh.source_note: HII REMUS 300 3.0-kWh configuration: up to 20 h at 3 kt.

REMUS 300 - 4.5 kWh.sensor_load_basis: Published endurance condition does not explicitly identify sensor-load inclusion.
REMUS 300 - 4.5 kWh.source_note: HII REMUS 300 4.5-kWh configuration: up to 30 h at 3 kt.

REMUS 600 - 5.2 kWh.sensor_load_basis: Public REMUS 600 endurance varies with speed, battery configuration, and sensor use.
REMUS 600 - 5.2 kWh.source_note: Commercial REMUS 600 entry replaces the MK18/Kingfish alias. Standard 5.2-kWh rechargeable configuration with the cited 24-h planning baseline. Recharge is a 4 h/kWh estimate.

REMUS 620 - 3 battery / no payload.sensor_load_basis: The cited 110-h configuration is explicitly a no-payload condition.
REMUS 620 - 3 battery / no payload.source_note: HII REMUS 620 3-battery/no-payload condition: 28.9 kWh, 110 h, 509 km, approximately 2.5-3 kt. Replaces the old mixed 15-kWh/110-h entry.

REMUS 6000 - 17.55 kWh.sensor_load_basis: Standard side-scan sonar is listed, but the 25-h endurance statement does not resolve sensor-load inclusion.
REMUS 6000 - 17.55 kWh.source_note: HII REMUS 6000: up to 17.55 kWh, up to 25 h, speeds up to 4.2 kt. Nominal 3 kt used for the planning catalog; recharge is a 4 h/kWh estimate.

Bluefin-9 - 1.9 kWh.sensor_load_basis: Published endurance condition does not explicitly identify sensor-load inclusion.
Bluefin-9 - 1.9 kWh.source_note: General Dynamics Bluefin-9: 1.9 kWh, 8 h at 3 kt, up to 5 kt. Recharge is a 4 h/kWh estimate.

Bluefin-12 - 7.6 kWh.sensor_load_basis: Speed-dependent endurance is published; sensor-load inclusion is not explicit.
Bluefin-12 - 7.6 kWh.source_note: General Dynamics Bluefin-12: 7.6 kWh; 24 h at 3 kt selected as the catalog baseline. The 36-h at 2-kt point remains reference data. Recharge is a 4 h/kWh estimate.

Bluefin-21 - 13.5 kWh.sensor_load_basis: The 25-h endurance condition is explicitly stated with the standard payload.
Bluefin-21 - 13.5 kWh.source_note: General Dynamics Bluefin-21: 13.5 kWh, 25 h at 3 kt with standard payload, up to 4.5 kt. Recharge is a 4 h/kWh estimate.

Iver3 580 Standard - 0.8 kWh.sensor_load_basis: Endurance is explicitly payload/current dependent; exact sensor inclusion is not resolved.
Iver3 580 Standard - 0.8 kWh.source_note: L3Harris Iver3 580 Standard: 0.8 kWh, 5-6 h at 2.5 kt, payload/current dependent. The 5-h endpoint is used as the conservative catalog baseline.

Iver3 EP - 0.8 kWh.source_note: L3Harris Iver3 EP: 0.8 kWh, 8-14 h at 2.5 kt. The 8-h endpoint is used as the conservative catalog baseline.

Iver4 580 - 0.78 kWh.sensor_load_basis: Published endurance condition does not explicitly identify sensor-load inclusion.
Iver4 580 - 0.78 kWh.source_note: L3Harris Iver4 580: 0.78 kWh, 6 h, up to 4.5 kt survey and above 5 kt sprint. Recharge is a 4 h/kWh estimate.

Iver4 900 - 2.0 kWh NiMH.sensor_load_basis: Manufacturer endurance is payload/current dependent; exact sensor inclusion is not resolved.
Iver4 900 - 2.0 kWh NiMH.source_note: L3Harris Iver4 900 standard NiMH: 2 kWh and 20+ h. Replaces the unsupported 14-h Navy-alias entry. Recharge is a 4 h/kWh estimate.

Iver4 900 - 4.0 kWh Li-ion.sensor_load_basis: Manufacturer endurance is payload/current dependent; exact sensor inclusion is not resolved.
Iver4 900 - 4.0 kWh Li-ion.source_note: L3Harris Iver4 900 Li-ion: 4 kWh and 40+ h. Recharge is a 4 h/kWh estimate.

Sentry - 13 kWh validation profile.sensor_load_basis: WHOI states endurance depends on mission type; exact sensor-load inclusion differs by mission.
Sentry - 13 kWh validation profile.source_note: WHOI Sentry 13-kWh validation profile uses the conservative 18-h endpoint of the published 18-40 h range. Nominal 1.2 kt is a validation-profile value based on the field missions, not a manufacturer cruise-speed claim.

Sentry - 18 kWh validation profile.sensor_load_basis: WHOI states endurance depends on mission type and depth.
Sentry - 18 kWh validation profile.source_note: WHOI Sentry 18-kWh validation profile uses the conservative 26-h endpoint of the published 26-60 h on-bottom range. Nominal 1.2 kt is a validation-profile value based on the field missions.

Autosub5 - 25 kWh validation profile.sensor_load_basis: The cited 24-h statement explicitly says all sensors operating.
Autosub5 - 25 kWh validation profile.source_note: NOC Autosub5 validation profile: five 5-kWh batteries and approximately 24 h with all sensors operating. Nominal 2.5 kt and 3.0-kt planning max are validation-profile values based on JC237 mission speeds. Recharge is a 4 h/kWh estimate.

GEOMAR ABYSS - 11.2 kWh.sensor_load_basis: GEOMAR ties the 20-h endurance condition directly to the sidescan-sonar configuration.
GEOMAR ABYSS - 11.2 kWh.source_note: GEOMAR ABYSS: two 5.6-kWh Li-ion batteries (11.2 kWh total), 2.5-3.5 kt, up to 20 h with sidescan sonar and up to 16 h with multibeam sonar. The 20-h sidescan condition is used here. Recharge is a 4 h/kWh estimate.
